cases.task: Choose the safe ordering rule for a browser consuming a versioned SSE protocol where ready certifies the requested baseline and cursor_ahead rejects it.

required_facts.text: A new connection has no certified application cursor until its first ready frame is accepted.
event, page, and terminal_error are application evidence relative to a certified baseline.
cursor_ahead is the mutually exclusive rejection alternative to the initial ready handshake.
Out-of-order frames must close fail-closed without changing cursor or rendering evidence.
